messages:
jessica_m: heads-up — during the EU region maintenance we saw an HSM 'blackout' for ~12m impacting BYOK customers. raising a quick thread to align on RBAC-safe recovery steps and audit evidence we should preserve. anyone oncall?
rajiv_s: saw the alert. oncall pinged. main concerns: operator unlock flows, any emergency escrow unwraps, and making sure we capture attestation + timestamps for compliance. :eyes:
oliver_oncall: I was in the run during the window. HSM nodes lost network to the KMS proxy for ~12:07–12:19 UTC, auto-failover retried and recovered. no customer key material exported, but a couple of operator sessions were opened while we were troubleshooting.
anna_prod: do we have a list of which customers had BYOK keys pinned to the affected HSM cluster? need to notify legal/compliance if we did any manual unwrapping.
securitybot: incident created: INC-2026-0427. linked logs: https://redwood-infra/ops/incidents/INC-2026-0427.
rajiv_s: quick checklist proposal: 1) freeze any operator-initiated wrap/unwrap actions for the cluster snapshot 2) collect HSM audit logs and attestation certs 3) capture KMS proxy logs + RBAC audit events 4) run rewrap/escrow verification if any key handling happened.
jessica_m: agree. can we capture commands to pull those logs? oliver?
oliver_oncall: yes. short commands:
```
# export HSM audit stream (since 2026-04-27T12:00Z)
hsm-cli export-audit --cluster eu-hsm-03 --since 2026-04-27T12:00Z --until 2026-04-27T12:30Z > /tmp/hsm-eu-04-27.json
# proxy logs from k8s
kubectl logs -n kms-proxy pod/kms-proxy-eu-01 --since=30m > /tmp/kms-proxy-eu-04-27.log
# RBAC events from auth service
authctl query-events --resource hsm --since=2026-04-27T12:00Z > /tmp/rbac-events-eu-04-27.json
```
sam_audit: capture the attestation chain too: `attestctl fetch --cluster eu-hsm-03 --format pem > /tmp/attest-eu.pem`. We need signed evidence for customers who request it.
rajiv_s: also snapshot operator sessions: `auditctl sessions --cluster eu-hsm-03 --from 2026-04-27T12:00Z --to 2026-04-27T12:30Z` — we must record session IDs, operator principals, and 2FA proofs.
anna_prod: customer comms question — what triggers mandatory customer notification? If there was no export/unwrap of customer key material and no policy bypass, can we do notification-only for affected accounts vs broad disclosure? Legal prefers conservative approach but wants facts first.
rajiv_s: policy: if any manual unwrap or key material left the HSM, escalate and notify. If only sessions and failed connections but no unwrap, create advisory with full audit pack and offer attestations on request. I'll verify the org policy doc.
jessica_m: RBAC changes — one operator reported temporary elevated access to run diagnostics (we allowed a debug role). Need to record who granted it and why. Any way to capture ephemeral grants?
oliver_oncall: yes, our auth service logs grant requests as events. snippet: `authctl grant-history --principal operator.jlee --resource eu-hsm-03 --since 2026-04-27T11:50Z` — that shows TTL and approver. We'll export that.
rajiv_s: if there was an ad-hoc RBAC exception, we must 1) document justification, 2) rotate any short-lived tokens issued, 3) include in postmortem and in customer audit packs.
sam_audit: for compliance, include a chain-of-custody doc in the pack: timeline, full log exports, attestation certs, operator session transcripts, and a digest of any code run against key material. Keep checksums (sha256) for each exported file.
jessica_m: good call. also: do we have an automated rewrap check — if someone did a manual rewrap to move key to a different HSM, we need to validate provenance.
rajiv_s: rewrap validation: check HSM audit for `wrap_key`/`unwrap_key` events with key_id, source_slot, dest_slot and attestation tokens. If we see `unwrap_key` followed by `wrap_key` within a minute and the operator is a human, escalate. If performed by replica-sync daemon with attestation, document it.
anna_prod: what's our customer-facing stance on escrow? some customers require escrow proofs when we had to help in recovery. Can we provide a signed proof that we never exported raw key material?
sam_audit: yes — we can provide signed attestations from the HSM vendor plus our own digest of the audit stream. HSM attestation shows key objects never left the secure boundary — include vendor attestation cert + signed timestamp.
oliver_oncall: implementation note: snapshots must be immutable. store exported artifacts in secure bucket with restricted ACLs and write-once retention: `gsutil cp /tmp/*-eu-04-27* gs://redwood-secure/incidents/INC-2026-0427/` then set ACL and retention.
jessica_m: follow-up items: - oliver: export logs + make secure snapshot - rajiv: verify RBAC grant history & policy mapping - sam: prepare audit pack template and compute checksums - anna: hold off on customer comms until we confirm any unwraps
rajiv_s: I'll also draft a short runbook addendum for HSM-blackout scenarios: include immediate freeze, evidence capture commands, who to notify (legal/compliance/customer-success), and how to validate rewraps.
anna_prod: thanks — please @legal and @cs when you have the audit pack. I'll coordinate messaging.
securitybot: reminder: add incident label `byok-affecting` if any customer key objects show `unwrap_key` or `export` events.
jessica_m: quick question — is there a required wait before rotating keys for affected customers? don't want to rotate unnecessarily and break customer rollouts.
rajiv_s: recommend: don't rotate keys unless proof of compromise (export/unsupported unwrap) exists. If we perform a rotation due to operational help we provided (e.g., we performed a rewrap on behalf of customer), schedule rotation with customer consent and document the handoff.
oliver_oncall: exported snapshots uploaded to secure bucket and ACLs set. shared hashes in INC ticket. attaching: `/tmp/hsm-eu-04-27.json (sha256: abcd1234...)` — will hand to sam for audit pack.
sam_audit: got them. starting the audit pack now. planning a 48h internal review cycle then publish advisory.
jessica_m: perfect. after we close the evidence loop let's sync for a short postmortem and an action item list (RBAC tightening, authctl automation for ephemeral grants, and CI tests for failover). :thumbsup:
